tei:div.tei:p:
O remember unto us the covenant made with the patriarchs, as thou hast promised,Levit. xxvi. 45. “I will for their sakes remember the covenant with their ancestors, when I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am the Lord.” Act by us as thou hast assured us,Levit. xxvi. 44. “And yet for all that, though they be in the land of the enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am the Lord their God.” Restore our captivity and compassionate us, as it is written,Deut. xxx. 3. “The Lord thy God will restore thy captivity, and have mercy upon thee, and he will again gather thee from all the nations whither the Lord thy God hath scattered thee.” O gather our dispersed, as it is written,Deut. xxx. 4. “If thy outcasts be at the utmost parts of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee.” Cause our transgressions to vanish as a cloud, and as a vapour: as thou hast promised,Isaiah xliv. 22. “I have made thy
transgressions vanish away like a cloud, and thy sins like a vapour: return unto me for I have redeemed thee.” Efface our transgressions for thy own sake, as thou hast promised,Isaiah xliii. 25. “I, even I, am HE who blotteth out thy transgressions for my own sake, and thy sins I will not remember.” O cause our sins to become white as snow and wool: as it is written,Isaiah i. 18. “Come now, let us reason together, saith the Lord; though your sins be as scarlet, they shall become white as snow; though they be red as crimson, they shall become like wool.” Sprinkle purifying water upon us, to cleanse us: as it is written,Ezek. xxxvi. 25. “And I will sprinkle upon you clean water, and ye shall be cleansed from all your impurity, and from all your idolatry will I cleanse you.” Have mercy upon us, and destroy us not: as it is written,Deut. iv. 31. “For the Lord thy God is a merciful God; he will not forsake thee, nor destroy thee; and he will not forget the covenant with thy ancestors which he sware unto them.” O circumcise our hearts to love and revere thy name: as it is written,Deut. xxx. 6. “The Lord thy God will circumcise thy heart, and the hearts of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, in order that thou mayest live.” O be thou found by us, when we seek thee; as it is written,Deut. iv. 29. “But thou wilt seek the Lord thy God from there, and wilt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart, and with all thy soul.” Lead us unto thy holy mountain, and cause us to rejoice in thy house of prayer: as it is written,Isaiah lvi. 7. “And I will bring them unto my holy mountain, and I will make them rejoice in my house of prayer: their burnt-offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted on my altar; for my house shall be called the house of prayer for all nations.”
